card.name: Words right before a job title
card.fires_on: Small linking words or a title word right after a leadership role, where a person's job title or name is about to follow. Examples are "Principal and", "head of the", "president and", and "justice of the".

modes.label: Linked job titles
modes.description: The word "and" after a role such as president or principal, just before a second title.
modes.example: Jennifer Helgeson, president<< and>> CEO of Boys and Girls Clubs of Kent

modes.label: Of or the after a head role
modes.description: "of" or "the" after a role such as head or justice, before the office or body named.
modes.example: Parizeau resigned and was replaced by the head of<< the>> federal Bloc Québécois, Luc

modes.label: Spokesman before a name
modes.description: A role word like spokesman placed just before the person's name.
modes.example: Iraqi government<< spokesman>> Ali al-Dabbagh said in a

card.writes: It pushes toward job-title words like teacher, coach and manager, and away from deputy and minister titles.
card.plain: It fires when a leadership job title is being spelled out and the next word will likely be another role or a name.
